load_seqeval_metric: load the seqeval metric using evaluate.load for sequence labeling evaluation
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the seqeval metric interactive evaluation interface
compute_seqeval_metrics: compute precision, recall, and F1 scores for named entity recognition predictions
evaluate_sequence_labels: evaluate sequence labeling predictions against ground truth labels
run_seqeval_evaluation: run seqeval evaluation on prediction and reference label sequences
